Hi team,

Attaching a compact MAP template I mocked up for Helios (first pass). The ask from the AE was to keep the initial doc tight — 4 weeks, clear technical gates, and an acceptance matrix that procurement can use. Key constraints: Helios needs a 30-day pilot window, limited access to staging, and a procurement lead who wants milestones in the contract.

Notes in the doc:
- Week 0: provisioning + baseline test plan (admin access, sample dataset)
- Week 1: integration smoke tests + representative prompt set
- Week 2: performance/latency baseline and quantization check
- Week 3: acceptance validation and sign-off checklist

I left placeholders for owners and suggested owners where appropriate. Can you:
1) Review the acceptance matrix and add any compliance gates we should surface for Procurement.
2) Tighten the technical checkpoints — Jasmine, can you call out the exact KV cache / prefix caching checks?
3) Ben — economics note: I included a recommended burst buffer and a dedicated slot for the pilot; please add a short pricing blurb.

I'll prep a 15-min kickoff deck (slides link in attachments) we can share with Helios tomorrow if this looks good.

Thanks,
Olga

Please review the doc and add comments directly (suggested edits turned on). If Procurement prefers, we can extract the acceptance matrix into the SOW appendix.

If those dates don't work, tell me a couple options and we'll adapt.

Best,
